primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The number of participants achieving success in the S-IGA scale is presented for each arm. Success is defined as an S-IGA score of 0 ('clear') or 1 ('almost clear'), plus a 2-grade improvement from baseline.The S-IGA is 5-point scale assessing the severity of plaque psoriasis on the scalp, with scores ranging from 0 ('clear') to 4 ('severe'). Higher scores indicate greater symptom severity.

groups.description: Participants applied roflumilast foam 0.3% QD for 8 weeks. Areas of application were all areas affected, including the scalp, face, trunk, and intertriginous regions. There was a 1-week follow-up period after completing treatment.
groups.title: Roflumilast Foam 0.3%
